races.paceDynamic: Dos Mukasan is the sole confirmed front runner and will set the early tempo from the gates. Key Witness, Collecting Coin, Dmaniac and Gerrit's Gem should track close behind in prominent positions, creating a solid group within the first four furlongs. The large field of hold-up horses including Gleneagle Bay, Final Voyage, Aviatrice and Nancy J will be positioned off the pace, relying on strong finishing kicks. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can sit close enough to strike but avoid the front-running burden that Dos Mukasan must carry under top weight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is honest but not overly strong with Dos Mukasan controlling from the front
scenarios.body: Key Witness and Collecting Coin can track the leader comfortably and have enough left to outfinish him in the straight, while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground on the yielding surface.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Challenge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If Dos Mukasan sets a strong pace under pressure from prominent runners
scenarios.body: The pace collapses in the final two furlongs allowing Aviatrice and Gleneagle Bay to close from off the pace with their superior class ratings.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Dos Mukasan faces little early pressure and conserves energy through moderate fractions
scenarios.body: His class from French victories tells as he maintains the lead throughout, while prominent runners lack the pace to get by and hold-up horses start their moves too late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Emerges Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely run throughout creating a truly-run race scenario
scenarios.body: Quatre Bras benefits from his recent turf form improvement and gets the strong pace he needs for his finishing kick to be effective.

watchPoints.text: Dos Mukasan faces a potentially impossible task carrying 140lbs as the lone front runner in a 14-runner handicap
Aviatrice returns after 177 days off her Listed AW win but drops 7lbs in the weights if fully tuned
Key Witness has won his last two starts and Alan Persse's 5lb claim makes him effectively the best-treated runner
The going has deteriorated from Good To Soft to Yielding which will test the stamina reserves of all runners
Gerrit's Gem has won three times at Cork including over this 7f trip and represents stable debut value

races.paceDynamic: Royal Bay Cen, Tornado Kiss, Bear On The Run, and Rosie Frith will clash for the early lead, creating a fierce gallop from the off. The prominent runners Havana Anna, Ipanema Queen, and Thenandnow face traffic dangers in the congested pack behind four confirmed front-runners. With such strong pace pressure over 5½f, the leaders will burn each other up in the opening half-mile. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and those who can settle off the pace, as the early gallop will set up a staying test that rewards late finishers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the four front-runners go too fast early and weaken significantly
scenarios.body: Oh Cecelia's hold-up style becomes a major asset as she picks off tired leaders, while Havana Anna can use her class to sweep past fading pace-setters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Avoid Traffic
scenarios.trigger: If Havana Anna and Ipanema Queen can secure clean runs behind the leaders
scenarios.body: Their superior class tells as they avoid the early pace battle but stay close enough to strike, with the pace still strong enough to soften up the front rank.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: One Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Royal Bay Cen or Tornado Kiss can steal a march while rivals fight for position
scenarios.body: The winner gets first run on the field and holds on grimly, taking advantage of their rivals' positioning battles to build an unassailable lead.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Midfield Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is just moderate enough to allow tactical runners to stay in touch
scenarios.body: Thenandnow's recent form improvement and Dawn Romance's course familiarity allow them to benefit from a perfectly-judged ride through traffic.

watchPoints.text: Royal Bay Cen, Tornado Kiss, Bear On The Run, and Rosie Frith creating excessive pace pressure that burns them all up
Havana Anna and Ipanema Queen getting trapped behind the wall of leaders with nowhere to go at the business end
Oh Cecelia getting the perfect tow behind the strong gallop to unleash her finishing kick
Quiet Mutiny's inexperience showing when the pace quickens in this much stronger company
The ground conditions affecting the sprint finish, with several runners unproven on yielding surfaces

races.paceDynamic: Happy Pharoah will take them along from the front with minimal early pressure, as the prominent runners Helvic Dream, Taipan, Star Harbour and Londonofficecallin are unlikely to press aggressively early. This sets up a moderate gallop through the first mile with the large field bunching behind the leaders. The race will develop into a sprint finish over the final three furlongs as the hold-up horses Navy Waters, Comfort Zone, Zoffman, Truth Be Told, Mocking, Alba Chiara, Genoah and Thatwilldoso unleash their challenges. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up merchants who can deliver a sustained finish on the testing ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Happy Pharoah sets only a moderate pace and the race becomes tactical
scenarios.body: The large field will converge entering the straight creating traffic problems for prominent racers while the patient hold-up horses get clear runs and superior finishing kicks. Navy Waters, Comfort Zone and Truth Be Told are perfectly positioned to exploit this scenario with their proven staying power at the trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens approaching the straight and some hold-up horses get blocked
scenarios.body: Happy Pharoah and Helvic Dream can utilise their forward positions to steal vital lengths while others are still organising their challenges behind. The yielding ground will blunt some finishing kicks allowing the prominent duo to hold on.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Happy Pharoah gets soft fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: His Leopardstown specialist record and proven stamina reserves allow him to build an unassailable lead before the closers can respond. The testing conditions will sap the energy from late-running horses attempting to make up significant ground.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Unexposed Improver Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the race develops into a true staying test favouring lightly-raced types
scenarios.body: Truth Be Told's trainer switch and step back up in trip could unlock significant improvement that catches more exposed rivals off guard. Lifting Sails also fits this profile having shown promise in limited turf appearances.

watchPoints.text: Happy Pharoah could steal this if allowed uncontested lead as his three Leopardstown wins prove his effectiveness when controlling pace
Navy Waters represents clear danger from rear given his proven stamina at this trip and victory over Alba Chiara previously
Truth Be Told switching trainers after 206-day break could produce significant improvement when stepping back up to preferred distance
Comfort Zone showed strong finishing effort when third at Naas in October suggesting readiness for longer trip challenge
Track any market move for Genoah given his low turf rating may not reflect true ability despite limited grass experience

races.paceDynamic: L L Koulsty appears the most natural pace-setter with proven front-running ability, likely to get an uncontested lead given the predominantly prominent/hold-up field composition. The large contingent of prominent runners (Harmani, Jojo's Legacy, Kalir, Coincidental Glory, Venetian Star, Johnny Soda) will likely settle just behind the leader rather than pressure early. With hold-up horses Arctic Assassin, Matilda Joslyngage, Bear Right and Grey Intentions waiting in rear, this sets up a steady gallop with the real action delayed until the final 2-3 furlongs. This pace scenario strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can utilize the uncontested fractions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If L L Koulsty gets soft fractions without early pressure
scenarios.body: The proven course winner controls from the front while prominent runners hesitate to commit early on the yielding ground. L L Koulsty's stamina proves decisive as hold-up horses find insufficient pace to close effectively.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Develops
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners press L L Koulsty from halfway
scenarios.body: Harmani, Johnny Soda and Kalir engage the leader turning in, creating a strong gallop that exposes stamina limitations. The most resolute stayer among the prominent group prevails in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely in the final quarter-mile
scenarios.body: Arctic Assassin and Matilda Joslyngage benefit from an overly steady tempo that allows their finishing kicks to be effective. The Curragh winner Arctic Assassin's recent form advantage proves decisive in a tactical finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If no horse wants to make the running early
scenarios.body: The field bunches dangerously with multiple runners hitting the front simultaneously in the final furlong. Chaos ensues with any horse capable of quickening late having chances regardless of rating.

watchPoints.text: L L Koulsty breaking fast and getting uncontested fractions will be extremely difficult to peg back
Arctic Assassin settling kindly in rear given recent winning form provides significant closing threat
Matilda Joslyngage's ability to handle the step back up in class after 206-day absence
Johnny Soda and Venetian Star both running prominently early will indicate if genuine pace pressure develops
Multiple prominent runners bunching turning in could create traffic problems for hold-up horses

races.paceDynamic: Zitkala Sa and Aravalli will contest the early lead in this fillies maiden, with both confirmed front-runners likely to post honest fractions over the 1m2½f trip on yielding ground. The honest gallop they set will create a tactical race where the prominent runners like Contrite can track the pace, while the hold-up horses including Yousaynothingatall, Lake Bonney and Dreamkeeper will have plenty to do from the back. The sustained gallop and testing ground conditions heavily favour the prominent racers and early position runners over pure hold-up performers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders engage early and create honest fractions throughout
scenarios.body: The sustained pace will set up perfectly for horses like Contrite and the debut runners with prominent styles to strike late. Hold-up horses will struggle to make up ground on the testing surface against the solid gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes overly strong between Zitkala Sa and Aravalli
scenarios.body: The front-runners will weaken in the final furlong, allowing the proven hold-up performers to close strongly. Yousaynothingatall's class and Lake Bonney's Ballydoyle polish become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders gets an uncontested lead and dictates moderate fractions
scenarios.body: Either Aravalli or Zitkala Sa will kick clear entering the straight and hold on gamely. The lack of early pressure allows the pace-setter to reserve enough energy for the finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the debut runners show significantly more ability than their pedigrees suggest on paper
scenarios.body: The combination of freshness and untapped potential allows one of the first-time starters to overcome their inexperience. The yielding ground plays to their advantage as stamina types.

watchPoints.text: Yousaynothingatall drops significantly in class after near-miss in handicap company and could outclass this maiden field

If either Zitkala Sa or Aravalli gets an uncontested early lead the pace could collapse and favour the front-runner

runners_data.comment: Disappointing debut at Dundalk in Dec', surely capable of better but a bit to prove
runners_data.spotlight: Frankel colt was sent off at just 9-2 on debut at Dundalk in December (1m) but missed the break and never really threatened; surely capable of better and bred to stay this longer trip but a bit to prove.

runners_data.spotlight: Rated 69 after three maiden runs at 7f-1m2f; beaten 11.5l when seventh of 13 at Navan on latest (1m2f, heavy); new tongue tie needs to eke out much more.

races.paceDynamic: Frank Pickle is the only confirmed front runner in this 13-runner maiden, meaning he can dictate terms without early pressure over this testing 1m2½f trip on yielding ground. The pace will be sustainable rather than punishing, with prominent runners like Sunrush and Dreamed To Dream likely to track behind Frank Pickle through the early stages. With most of the field comprising hold-up horses including Atomic City, Hard Promises, and the lightly-raced Gaelic Drills, the race will develop into a patient affair before the real action begins in the final three furlongs. This controlled pace scenario clearly favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed who can position close to the pace, as the hold-up brigade will face a wall of horses when making their moves.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Suits Prominent
scenarios.trigger: If Frank Pickle sets uncontested fractions and the pace stays steady
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair where horses positioned handy can kick clear before the backmarkers organize their challenges. Prominent runners with class get first run on the field.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge From Quality
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes crawling
scenarios.body: The race turns into a sprint finish where the highest-rated horses with natural ability can overcome poor positioning. Class tells in a bunched finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Folds Early
scenarios.trigger: If Frank Pickle doesn't handle the yielding ground or trips
scenarios.body: The race lacks early pace and becomes messy with no clear leader, suiting horses that can adapt tactically. Mid-division runners benefit from the chaos.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If one of the newcomers or lightly-raced horses shows unexpected improvement
scenarios.body: A horse with hidden ability or significant improvement takes advantage of weak opposition in this moderate maiden. Breeding and connections matter.

watchPoints.text: Frank Pickle could get an uncontested lead but may not stay this trip on testing ground under pressure
Hard Promises is a complete unknown on debut but expensive breeding suggests significant ability
Gaelic Drills showed promise on debut for Bolger and is open to major improvement
Atomic City needs cover in running but could struggle to get competitive position from wide draw
Track the market moves on Roi Du Nord and Abbotsford as both have question marks but potential upside
